implemented: GDD conclusion comes from the current accepted dispatch's root native final result, using the existing explicit complete/blocked parser; no separate GDD receipt file is assigned.
Native completion checks the final conclusion and saved draft; the host reuses the existing GDD draft validator before advancing. Invalid index structure is not deferred merely because prose exists.

Preserve author-selected outcome/acceptance associations in the existing index. Host metadata finalization remains unchanged; no inferred semantic index or inline handoff data in prose.
Preserve distinct initial delivery instructions; deduplicate only an identical confirmed-input payload and avoid double-escaping structured GDD requirements.
Prepare target directories and simplify stable BGS guidance; do not change the system prompt by phase, tool availability, permissions, native history mechanics, Skills or turn limits.
Remove obligatory receipt-file work and unnecessary numbering/title-check guidance, without forbidding source investigation or necessary repair.
